decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service gained its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and it complements the identity offering and the security needs of the firm's GIS customers.

The open GIS application development framework sits close to the firm's core platform business and its open-component strategy, though in 2024 it was still only mentioned rather than featured on a page of its own.
The identity service is actively promoted with a dedicated page and launch messaging, and it addresses a recurring integration need for public and private customers.
The consulting workshop builds on the firm's consulting and training strengths, costs little to maintain and serves as an entry point to larger projects.
